investigations.name: island-biogeography
investigations.title: Island biogeography: a Lotka-Volterra metacommunity under contract
investigations.description:
A faithful process-bigraph port of vivarium-collective/island-biogeography
(experiments/island_lotka_volterra.py + experiments/island_food_web.py). Each
island is an IslandProcess running the discrete Lotka-Volterra step with a
carrying-capacity rescale; a single MigrationProcess couples them with
distance-stochastic single-individual migration and random species
introduction. Three studies interrogate the model against island-biogeography
theory: carrying-capacity scaling (area -> abundance), the isolation gradient
+ migration conservation, and the role of trophic structure in the
species-area law.
